world.topic:
A check of a world whose network lists the hosts it reaches. This is not research: each step is a command, and its exact output is the result.

Experiment position: run each of these and keep the full output, status lines and bodies included, in `checks/network.md`: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://pypi.org/simple/`; `curl -sS -D - https://example.com/`; `curl -sS -D - http://example.com/`; `pip download --no-deps -d /tmp/pkgs tabulate`. Deliver `checks/network.md`.

Paper position: `report/report.md`, a table of the four commands and what each answered, taken from the experiment position's `checks/network.md`.
